agentSummary: Adds tools for UAF Layer Stacks (UE 5.8, experimental): author layers over animation assets, set default weights and blend times, bind a stack to an actor and drive layer enable, disable and weight events in Play In Editor.
enablesAgentTo: Create UAF Layer Stack assets and inspect their layers, weights and blend settings
Add, configure and remove layers backed by animation sequences, blend spaces or UAF graphs
Bind a layer stack to an actor's UAF component and verify layer weights in PIE through the skeletal mesh pose
whenToEnable: Your project uses the experimental Unreal Animation Framework layering plugin (UAFLayering, UE 5.8).
